_why_lib: As T604-T608: a files-scoped compile does not pick up the DOM lib the full-tree compile gets through a dependency. CI's tsc --noEmit over the root config remains the authoritative backend typecheck.
_why_tests: The root tsconfig EXCLUDES __tests__, and ts-jest runs with isolatedModules (transpile, no typecheck), so a suite can pass while its file does not compile - T605 lost a pass to exactly that, and T608's it.each tuple widening was caught here and nowhere else. The new suites are listed on purpose.
